|game_text=While 'communing': you may not deploy [Maintenance] cards or [Episode I] Jedi; Rebels of ability < 5 draw one battle destiny if unable to otherwise and, once per turn, may lose 1 Force (or use 2 Force) to place one just forfeited in Used Pile; once per turn, may ▼ a Tatooine battleground (or [[Tatooine: Obi-Wan's Hut (V) (Virtual Block 7){{!}}Obi-Wan's Hut]]).
|errata_history=This is errata version PC-E5 of [[Master Kenobi (Virtual Block 7)]]; it is the current text. Other versions: [[Master Kenobi (Virtual Block 7)]] (original), [[Master Kenobi (Virtual Block 7) (Errata)]] (PC-E1), [[Master Kenobi (Virtual Block 7) (Errata 2)]] (PC-E2), [[Master Kenobi (Virtual Block 7) (Errata 3)]] (PC-E3) and [[Master Kenobi (Virtual Block 7) (Errata 4)]] (PC-E4). The image here is the Master List slip ([[:File:VL-history-1273-27-front-master.png]]), which prints this text; the Players Committee card image is its own version (see PC-E4). How these versions came about (Holotable data, the PC website card list, the Master List and the PC card images) is told in [[PC Legacy Virtual Transcription Error History]].
* '''Original''' ([[Master Kenobi (Virtual Block 7)]]): text of the Virtual Block 7.3 release sheet as first published (official text as of 3 June 2011). No copy of that first printing has been found; the text is the 23 June 2011 errata text without “[Maintenance] cards or”, which the Players Committee news post “5 immediate changes from the CBT” says the errata added: “While ‘communing’: you may not deploy [Episode I] Jedi; Rebels of ability < 5 draw one battle destiny if unable to otherwise and, once per turn, may place one just forfeited in Used Pile; Once per turn, may ▼ a Tatooine battleground (or Obi-Wan’s Hut).”.<ref name="sheet-VirtualBlock7_3">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock7_3.pdf#page=5 Virtual Block 7.3 release sheet] ("Official text as of 3 June 2011"; copy re-made 25 July 2011), page 5, slip 27 (position on the sheet; the slip prints no number). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261022223058/https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock7_3.pdf#page=5 Internet Archive]</ref><ref name="src-S6">Players Committee news post "5 immediate changes from the CBT", 23 June 2011. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20110824051300/http://www.starwarsccg.org/index.php?option=com_content&view=article&id=323:5-immediate-changes-from-the-cbt&catid=1:latest-news&Itemid=117 Internet Archive]</ref>
* '''PC-E1''' ([[Master Kenobi (Virtual Block 7) (Errata)]]): the Players Committee news post “5 immediate changes from the CBT” (23 June 2011) added “[Maintenance] cards or”; the re-made Virtual Block 7.3 release sheet (still headed 3 June 2011, PDF dated 25 July 2011) prints the same text: “While ‘communing’: you may not deploy [Maintenance] cards or [Episode I] Jedi; Rebels of ability < 5 draw one battle destiny if unable to otherwise and, once per turn, may place one just forfeited in Used Pile; Once per turn, may ▼ a Tatooine battleground (or Obi-Wan’s Hut).”.<ref name="src-S6">Players Committee news post "5 immediate changes from the CBT", 23 June 2011. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20110824051300/http://www.starwarsccg.org/index.php?option=com_content&view=article&id=323:5-immediate-changes-from-the-cbt&catid=1:latest-news&Itemid=117 Internet Archive]</ref><ref name="sheet-VirtualBlock7_3">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock7_3.pdf#page=5 Virtual Block 7.3 release sheet] ("Official text as of 3 June 2011"; copy re-made 25 July 2011), page 5, slip 27 (position on the sheet; the slip prints no number). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261022223058/https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock7_3.pdf#page=5 Internet Archive]</ref> The same Competitive Balance Team errata was posted on the Players Committee rules forum on 22 June 2011, effective immediately, a day before the news post<ref name="pcforum-p632630">Players Committee forum, Rules board, thread “Current Rulings/Errata” (t=48201, now titled “Current Rulings Archive July 2010 - August 2012”), post by Aglets, 22 June 2011 ([https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?t=48201&start=20#p632630 forum post])</ref>.
* '''PC-E2''' ([[Master Kenobi (Virtual Block 7) (Errata 2)]]): The Players Committee posted this errata on its rules forum on 11 April 2012 as a Competitive Balance Team errata, legal from 20 April 2012<ref name="pcforum-p710277">Players Committee forum, Rules board, thread “Current Rulings/Errata” (t=48201, now titled “Current Rulings Archive July 2010 - August 2012”), post by Aglets, 11 April 2012 ([https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?t=48201&start=40#p710277 forum post])</ref>. It added “may lose 1 Force (or use 2 Force) to” and changed “Pile; Once per turn” to “Pile; once per turn”: “While 'communing': you may not deploy [Maintenance] cards or [Episode I] Jedi; Rebels of ability < 5 draw one battle destiny if unable to otherwise and, once per turn, may lose 1 Force (or use 2 Force) to place one just forfeited in Used Pile; once per turn, may ▼ a Tatooine battleground (or Tatooine: Obi-Wan's Hut (V) (Virtual Block 7)|Obi-Wan's Hut).”
* '''PC-E3''' ([[Master Kenobi (Virtual Block 7) (Errata 3)]]): The PC website card list (shown there by 21 July 2012, the earliest archived capture with text, and still on 11 December 2012) printed “once per turn,” twice (as published); no other word changed (the card list writes the ▼ icon as “\/”): “While 'communing': you may not deploy [Maintenance] cards or [Episode I] Jedi; Rebels of ability < 5 draw one battle destiny if unable to otherwise and, once per turn, once per turn, may lose 1 Force (or use 2 Force) to place one just forfeited in Used Pile; once per turn, may ▼ a Tatooine battleground (or Tatooine: Obi-Wan's Hut (V) (Virtual Block 7)|Obi-Wan's Hut).”<ref name="cl-1273_27-2012-07-21">Players Committee website card list (VBlock7Type), as captured [https://web.archive.org/web/20120721064742/http://www.starwarsccg.org:80/cardlists/VBlock7Type.html 2012-07-21] and [https://web.archive.org/web/20121211205229/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock7Type.html 2012-12-11] (Internet Archive)</ref>
* '''PC-E4''' ([[Master Kenobi (Virtual Block 7) (Errata 4)]]): The Players Committee card image ([[:File:VB7-L-masterkenobi-pre.gif]], marked E; on the Players Committee's server by 25 February 2013<ref name="pc-img-date">Players Committee card image folder (<code>Virtual7-Light/large/</code>), web-server directory listing sorted by date: <code>masterkenobi.gif</code> last modified 25 February 2013, as captured [https://web.archive.org/web/20190818034736/https://starwarsccg.org/cardlists/images/starwars/Virtual7-Light/large/?C=M;O=A 18 August 2019] (Internet Archive); the file is byte-identical to today's.</ref>): “While 'communing': you may not deploy [Maintenance] cards or [Episode I] Jedi; Rebels of ability < 5 draw one battle destiny if unable to otherwise and, once per turn, may lose 1 Force (or use 2 Force) to place one just forfeited in Used Pile; Once per turn, may ▼ a Tatooine battleground (or Tatooine: Obi-Wan's Hut (V) (Virtual Block 7)|Obi-Wan's Hut).” It prints the forum text with a capital “Once” in “Used Pile; Once per turn”. A capitals or punctuation difference in a card document is a version (versions ruling of 9 November 2026), and a card image is placed at its date (versions ruling of 11 November 2026, 09:14). Its date is the folder's bulk upload date, so the image may have been made earlier; the version order follows that date (versions ruling of 11 November 2026, 08:45). The card image shows the card's art, prints the errata mark E bottom right and no slip number.
* '''PC-E5''' (this page): The Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (official text as of 27 April 2013; Light Side, p. 12)<ref name="ml-ls">[[Media:Virtual_Legacy_Final_Master_LS.pdf|Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (Light Side)]], cover "official text as of April 27, 2013" (PDF built February 2014). Original: http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterLS.pdf#page=12, page 12. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20170705013057/http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterLS.pdf#page=12 Internet Archive]</ref> prints the PC-E2 forum text again, word for word: “While 'communing': you may not deploy [Maintenance] cards or [Episode I] Jedi; Rebels of ability < 5 draw one battle destiny if unable to otherwise and, once per turn, may lose 1 Force (or use 2 Force) to place one just forfeited in Used Pile; once per turn, may ▼ a Tatooine battleground (or Tatooine: Obi-Wan's Hut (V) (Virtual Block 7)|Obi-Wan's Hut).” Every published text is a version, even a word-for-word repeat (versions ruling of 11 November 2026), so the Master List is listed as PC-E5. It is the last published text, so it is the current text. The Master List slip leaves the art box blank and prints the errata mark E, with no slip number.
